sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
supports: Section 1: Special Links must use the tagged link formats Amazon provides.
Section 5: the exact required disclosure sentence, and that it must appear clearly and prominently on the Site or wherever Program Content is displayed.
Section 5: you may not misrepresent or embellish the relationship, or imply that Amazon supports, sponsors or endorses you.
Section 6: violations of Section 5 are treated as a material breach.

quotes.text: You must clearly and prominently state the following, or any substantially similar statement previously allowed under this Agreement, on your Site or any other location where Amazon may authorize your display or other use of Program Content: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.”
The links must properly use the special “tagged” link formats we provide and comply with this Agreement (“Special Links”).

sources.title: Associates Program Policies
supports: Participation Requirements 1: the Site must contain original content, be publicly available, and third-party material must carry significant commentary, analysis or transformation.
Participation Requirements 1(g): no Amazon trademark, variant or misspelling in a domain name, subdomain, tag, Associates ID or social identifier.

Participation Requirements 2(b): every Special Link must carry the Associates tag as a URL parameter, must be accessed directly from the Site, and prices may only be shown if Amazon serves them or they come from Creators API / PA API.
Participation Requirements 2(b): no inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or misleading claims about a product, price or Amazon policy. No dynamic per-user sub-tags.
Trademark Guidelines 8: no trademark, domain, subdomain, username or app name confusingly similar to an Amazon mark.
IP License 1: Program Content may be copied and displayed solely on your Site; no data mining, robots or extraction tools.
IP License 2(h): images may not be stored or cached; other Product Advertising Content may be cached no longer than 24 hours. ASINs may be stored indefinitely.
IP License 2(i): a date/time stamp is required next to pricing or availability, plus a fixed prices-change disclaimer.
IP License 2(k): a fixed “CERTAIN CONTENT THAT APPEARS ... COMES FROM AMAZON” notice is required when text from Amazon is displayed.

quotes.text: you may not state that you are linking to a smartphone that has 128 GB of memory
(h) You will not store or cache Product Advertising Content consisting of an image
No Agent may access, use, or interact with Program Content unless, at all times, it identifies itself

sources.title: Associates Program Commission Income Statement (within Program Policies)
supports: A Qualifying Purchase begins when a customer clicks through a Special Link.
The tracking session runs 24 hours from the click, or ends earlier on an order or on a click-through of someone else's link.
Products added to cart may still qualify up to 89 days after the initial click-through.
Commission is normally paid about 60 days after the month in which it was earned.

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
supports: Disclose any financial relationship with a brand.
Place the disclosure so it is hard to miss; disclosures at the end of a page or behind a click are likely to be missed.
Use simple, clear language such as “advertisement”, “ad”, or “sponsored”.
Do not use vague terms such as “sp”, “spon”, or “collab”.
You cannot talk about your experience with a product you have not tried.
You cannot make up claims that would require proof the advertiser does not have.

quotes.text: Disclosures are likely to be missed if they appear only on an ABOUT ME or profile page, at the end of posts or videos, or anywhere that requires a person to click MORE.
You can’t talk about your experience with a product you haven’t tried.
